seoTitle: Generate Reports in Monday.com With Dashboards
metaDescription: Build reporting dashboards in Monday.com by linking multiple boards, adding Table and Chart widgets, and exporting summaries to Excel or PDF.
intro: Pulling data across multiple boards into one clean report is where Monday.com's dashboard tools really pay off. This guide covers creating a dedicated reporting dashboard, linking source boards, adding table and chart widgets, and exporting the final summary for stakeholders.

steps.heading: Create a reporting dashboard
steps.body: Set up a dedicated Dashboard from your workspace directory, optimized for high-level reporting.

steps.heading: Link your source boards
steps.body: Connect multiple boards to your reporting ecosystem to aggregate cross-departmental data.

steps.heading: Add a Table Widget
steps.body: Use the Table Widget to filter, group, and display critical rows and task details directly on your report.

steps.heading: Add Chart Widgets
steps.body: Visualize project breakdowns, resource allocation, and trends with Pie charts, Line graphs, and Bar charts.

steps.heading: Filter and export
steps.body: Configure Multi-Board Filters to slice by date range, owner, or status, then export to Excel, CSV, or PDF and set up automated email delivery.

faq.question: Can I pull data from multiple boards into one report?
faq.answer: Yes, linking multiple source boards to your dashboard lets you aggregate cross-departmental data in one place.

faq.question: What chart types are available?
faq.answer: Chart Widgets support Pie charts, Line graphs, and Bar charts to visualize different kinds of project data.

faq.question: Can I automate sending my report to stakeholders?
faq.answer: Yes, once exported to Excel, CSV, or PDF, you can set up automated email reporting schedules.

faq.question: Can I filter the report by a specific team member or date range?
faq.answer: Yes, Multi-Board Filters let you dynamically slice the report by custom date ranges, owners, or priority status.
